why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open app.synthra.org and sign in with X or a wallet. Signing in with a wallet only signs a message.
Under Portfolio, open Rewards and referrals and connect your X account.

Fund the account on mainnet. Arc uses USDC to pay for gas. Warning Points come only from real money at risk. Synthra's terms say: "You may lose some or all of your digital assets. Never invest more than you can afford to lose."
Add liquidity to a Synthra pool on Arc or Robinhood Chain and keep the position in range. Only in-range liquidity earns the largest share of points.
Swap or trade perps if you want the volume share. Perps need a Hyperliquid account you fund yourself, with a 5 USDC minimum.
Share your referral code from the rewards page if you want referral points.
costs: Nothing here is free. You pay a 0.10% Synthra fee on routed swaps and a 0.10% builder fee on Hyperliquid trades, plus gas. Launching a token costs a 2% curve fee. Liquidity positions carry the usual risk that the two assets move apart in price and leave you with less than you put in. Synthra's Perps screen on 18 October 2026, before signing in, with a BTC-USD chart, an order book and an order form
risks: Points have no stated value, and the only reward ever attached to them was withdrawn within hours. Synthra advertises itself as audited, but the one published audit covers only its bridge between Robinhood Chain and Arc, and that report's conclusion reads "NO DEPLOYMENT APPROVAL".
